jobs.done_when:
All of the following hold:
- The customer is verified and the verification is logged.
- Every requested dispute that passes the pre-filing rules and fits the account's open-dispute limit has been filed with file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281, with its category, provisional-credit decision and card_action.
- Any dispute held back by a rule, the limit or a failed match has been explained.
- Each card's most severe action has been performed once: a freeze; a closure with reason lost, stolen or fraud_suspected (plus a replacement if the customer wanted one and the tier allows it now, or the Entry-tier 48-hour wait explained); or nothing for keep_active.
- If a closed card was lost or stolen, the cross-product credit card check has been handed off.
- The customer has a per-dispute summary of provisional credit, timelines, any affidavit and card status.
- If a call failed, the failure has been explained and a transfer offered. A transfer on request happened only on the 4th request.

open_questions: The docs do not say which pin_compromised value applies when the customer kept the PIN written down with the lost card: it was neither shared on purpose nor observed. It could be 'yes_observed' or 'unknown'. Only 'yes_shared' removes provisional credit.

Doc 025 requires no pending transactions before a card is closed, but for lost, stolen and fraud closures it also says 'any pending transactions will still be processed'. It is unclear whether pending transactions block closing a lost or compromised card.

Doc 025 does not say whether a card that was lost and then used fraudulently should be closed with reason 'lost' or 'fraud_suspected'. This workflow uses the reason the customer reported (lost or stolen).

For Entry-tier accounts, the 48-hour wait means a replacement for a card closed in this conversation cannot be ordered during it. The docs do not say whether to schedule the order or have the customer call back.
No tool is named for issuing debit provisional credit. It is recorded only through provisional_credit_eligible, including the Rho-Bank ATM case where credit is 'issued immediately'.

steps.quote: Account must have been open for at least 3 business days (excluding weekends)

steps.do: Check: account_type checking; status OPEN; open at least 3 business days; no more than 1 ACTIVE card on the account; balance at least $25; customer at least 18; no PENDING card on the account; US domestic address. If a check fails, explain what blocks the order and stop.
steps.quote: Customer cannot have a pending debit card order for the same account (check debit_cards table for PENDING status)

steps.do: Find the tier from the account name (Entry: Light Blue, Light Green, Green Fee-Free; Mid: Blue, Green (checking); Premium: Evergreen; Elite: Bluest). Count cards with issue_reason lost/stolen/fraud/damaged issued in the last 12 months. Over the limit: Entry (2) must wait or pay a $25 excess fee; Mid (3) must wait or pay $15; Premium (5) must wait, with no fee option; Elite is unlimited.
steps.quote: Look for cards with issue_reason of 'lost', 'stolen', 'fraud', or 'damaged'

steps.do: For an Entry tier account, a replacement cannot be ordered until 48 hours after the card's closure. If that time has not passed, tell the customer the earliest time they can order and do not order now. Mid, Premium and Elite have no wait.
steps.if: account is Entry tier
steps.quote: 48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered

steps.do: Offer the delivery options the tier allows and their delivery_fee. Entry: STANDARD only, $0. Mid: STANDARD $0 or EXPEDITED $15. Premium: STANDARD/EXPEDITED $0, RUSH $35. Elite: all $0.
steps.quote: Ask customer for preferred delivery option (STANDARD, EXPEDITED, or RUSH) and explain fees.

steps.do: Offer card designs and their design_fee. Entry/Mid: CLASSIC $0, PREMIUM $10, CUSTOM $25. Premium: CLASSIC $0, PREMIUM $0, CUSTOM $15. Elite: all $0.
steps.quote: Ask customer for preferred card design (CLASSIC, PREMIUM, or CUSTOM) and explain fees.

steps.do: Confirm the mailing address. Tell the customer that any fee (delivery, design, excess replacement) will be deducted from the linked checking account.
steps.quote: Always inform the customer that the fee will be deducted from their checking account balance before placing the order.

steps.do: Unlock and call order_debit_card_5739 with the exact tier delivery_fee and design_fee.
steps.if: eligibility passed, the Entry 48-hour wait (if any) has passed, the replacement limit is met or the fee is accepted, and the customer wants the card
steps.quote: When using order_debit_card_5739, you must provide the exact delivery_fee and design_fee amounts based on the tier rules below.

steps.do: Tell the customer the delivery timeframe (STANDARD 7-10, EXPEDITED 3-5, RUSH 1-2 business days) and any fees. If the order failed (for example, insufficient funds for fees), explain why.
steps.quote: If the account has insufficient funds for delivery or design fees, the order will fail
